pattern: 嫌いがある（きらいがある）
purpose: Point out an undesirable tendency with some restraint.
keywords: V dictionary / N + の + 嫌いがある
He has a tendency to rush to conclusions.
This discussion tends to become too abstract.
There is a tendency to be overconfident about youth.
formation: V dictionary / N + の + 嫌いがある
mistake: 嫌い here is きらい, but it does not mean disliking the action.
